boundary.positive_fixture_policy: positive fixtures cover canonical behavior only
boundary.retired_surface_policy: retired modes, retired adapters, alternate acceptance paths, retired-source lanes, unsupported features, and runtime-dispatch residues must be rejection, strict-error, or absent-support metadata
boundary.legacy_positive_residue_disposition: legacy-looking, retired-route-looking, gate-looking, unsupported, or compatibility-looking fixture surfaces are canonical rejection candidates until indexed as positives with no diagnostic code and no retired-surface tag
